title: CoBoTemplateImportEnvelopeV1
description: Formal JSON schema v1.0 for CMS Template Import in CoBo Portal (Phase A contract).

schema_version.description: Import file format specification version. Must be exactly '1.0'. Distinct from template version_no.

metadata.description: Optional authoring and export provenance metadata.

source_system.description: Identifier of the source CoBo instance or external system.

type_id.description: Optional suggested template identifier slug. Server validates uniqueness at Validate and Confirm.

description.description: Template description (max 3200 bytes per CMS validation rules).

template_category.description: Primary template category: 'periodic' (chu kỳ) or 'irregular' (sự kiện bất thường).

group_id.description: Target taxonomy group ID (e.g. 'group-001' for periodic, 'group-002' for irregular). If omitted, derived from template_category.

deadline_strategy.description: Strategy for calculating the compliance deadline.

deadline_rule.description: Human-readable deadline rule string (e.g. 'Trong vòng 20 ngày kể từ khi kết thúc quý.', 'T+5').

periodicity.description: Cycle frequency. Required if template_category is periodic.

display_group_codes.description: Portal display group codes (e.g. ['display_groups_003']). If omitted or empty, derived from template_category.

applicability.description: Scope of applicability text (e.g. 'Doanh nghiệp niêm yết quy mô lớn').

report_content.description: Detailed reporting requirements and disclosure format.

channels_text.description: Publication channels (e.g. 'UBCKNN, SGDCK, Website công ty').

legal_risks_text.description: Legal risks and penalties for non-compliance.

id.description: Optional file-local citation key. Ignored for persistence; Confirm regenerates server-owned UUID.
Optional file-local checklist key. Ignored for persistence; Confirm regenerates server-owned UUID.

DeadlineConfigV1.description: Periodicity V2 schedule, duration, and applicability configuration.

applicable_from_mode.description: Applicability start authoring intent. CURRENT_SLOT or NEXT_SLOT clears stale frozen slot; SPECIFIC_SLOT preserves slot.

applicable_from_slot.description: Canonical frequency-native cycle label (e.g. '2026-Q1', '2026-03'). Used only when mode is SPECIFIC_SLOT.

applicable_to.description: Template end date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or empty for OPEN_ENDED. Valid past dates are preserved in Draft and warned in Preview.

duration_type.description: Working vs calendar day calculation for cycle start.

deadline_duration_type.description: Working vs calendar day calculation for deadline due date.

deadline_days.description: Number of days from cycle anchor to compliance deadline.

open_days_before.description: Number of days before cycle end when workflow task opens.

WorkflowDefinitionV1.description: Model A workflow step template definition.

step_id.description: Optional file-local step key. Stripped on normalize; Confirm always generates a fresh server UUID. Do not use DB UUIDs.

stage.description: Human-readable workflow step title (e.g. 'Thu thập thông tin', 'Rà soát pháp lý', 'Phê duyệt').

department.description: Preferred portable department reference. Validate resolves by exact code, else exact name, else mapping_required.

code.description: Portable department source code (human-authored, not DB UUID).

name.description: Human-readable department name visible in CMS catalog mapping.

department_id.description: Legacy portable department source code (same meaning as department.code). Not a DB UUID.

department_name.description: Legacy human-readable source department name (same meaning as department.name).

assignee_roles.description: Preferred static workflow role codes (e.g. ['reviewer','approver'] or aliases MAKER/REVIEWER/APPROVER). Not DB role UUIDs.

assignee_role_ids.description: Legacy alias for assignee_roles. Values are static role codes, not database primary keys.

processing_days.description: Step processing SLA duration in days (minimum 1).

enabled.description: Whether automated reminders are enabled for this step.

offsets_days.description: Days relative to deadline to send reminders (e.g. [-3, -1, 0]).

template_key.description: Deprecated/non-portable notification key. Cleared on import; not persisted.

name.description: Document requirement title (e.g. 'Báo cáo tài chính quý (PDF có chữ ký số)').

required.description: Whether this document must be uploaded before completing the step.

template_file_name.description: Informational metadata showing the recommended sample filename (e.g. 'Mau_01_BCTC.xlsx'). Binary is not imported.

template_file_id.description: Non-portable source storage ID. If provided, strictly cleared to '' upon import. Do not author this field.

TemplateApplicabilityRulesV1.description: Periodicity and company applicability rules for compliance determination.

applicable_company_classes.description: List of company classes obligation applies to (e.g. ['public_large', 'public_normal', 'public_listed']).

applicable_sectors.description: List of business sectors obligation applies to.

deadline_by_structure.description: Deadline offsets mapped by corporate structure criterion.

deadline_days.description: Number of days for deadline calculation.

deadline_day_type.description: Day type for deadline duration: 'calendar' or 'working'.
